# Read data

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| output: false

variables <- read.csv("Worksheets/PDRI_variables.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","N/A"))
variable_details <- read.csv("Worksheets/PDRI_variable_details.csv", header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("","NA","N/A"))

data <- read.csv("Data/Code generated/PDRI_curated_scores.csv", 
                 header = T, check.names=FALSE, na.strings=c("",".","NA", "N/A"))
```

# make the categorical variables as factor and update the labels if applicable

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

flag_print <- F
vec1 <- unique(variable_details$Short.name)
vec2 <- names(data)
for (var in intersect(vec1, vec2)) {
  if (flag_print) {
    print("-------------")
    print(table(data[var], useNA = "ifany"))
  }
  label_vec <- as.vector(unlist(variable_details %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(OptionLabel)))
  label_vec <- label_vec[!is.na(label_vec)]
  
  label_vec_2 <- as.vector(unlist(variable_details %>% filter(Short.name==var) %>% select(ShortLabel)))
  label_vec_2 <- label_vec_2[!is.na(label_vec_2)]
  
  if (!all(label_vec==label_vec_2)) # need to update labels
  {
    vec <- unlist(data[var])
    for (i in seq_len(length(label_vec))){
      vec[which(vec == label_vec[i])] <- label_vec_2[i]
    }
    data[var] <- vec
  }
  
  # make it factor with proper levels
  data[names(data)[which(names(data) == var)]] <- 
    lapply(data[names(data)[which(names(data) == var)]], factor, levels = label_vec_2)
  if (flag_print) {
    print(table(data[var], useNA = "ifany"))
    print(lapply(data[names(data)[which(names(data) == var)]], levels))
  }
}

# drop levels since some options in the variable detail sheet were never chosen
data <- data %>% droplevels()

levels(data$group) <- c("HC", "PD", "OND")
```

# Table 1: summary of the cohort

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# For the cohort who have complete PREDIGT 1.0 Questionnaire - original PREDIGT Score
df <- data

var_vec <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$Table1 == 1 & variables$Open.data == 1)]
name_vec <- variables$Long.name[which(variables$Table1 == 1 & variables$Open.data == 1)]

df_O_tbl1 <- df %>%
  select(group, group2,all_of(var_vec))
names(df_O_tbl1)[c(3:ncol(df_O_tbl1))] <- name_vec

df_O_tbl1 %>% select(-group2) %>% 
  tbl_summary(by = group,
              missing = "no") %>%
  add_p() %>%
  add_q() %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Variable**") %>% # update the column header
  modify_caption("Table 1. Patient Characteristics in Ottawa Trial: PREDIGT1.0 Questionnaire") %>%
  bold_labels() %>% 
  bold_p(t = 0.05) 
# %>% as_flex_table() 
```

## AUC (95% confidence interval)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# --------- ROC/AUC ---------

test_vec <- variables$Short.name[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
test_vec2 <- variables$Long.name[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
type1_vec <- variables$Type1[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
type2_vec <- variables$Type2[which(variables$ROC == 1)]
group_name <- levels(data$group)
directions <- c("<", "<", ">", ">", "<", "<")

resList <- list()
for (i_cohort in 1:2) {
  if (i_cohort == 1)
    # PREDIGT1 cohort
  {
    df_roc_temp <- data
  } else
    # all_component
  {
    df_roc_temp <- df_PREDIGT2
  }
  
  df <- df_roc_temp %>%
    mutate(group3 = ifelse(group == "PD", "PD", "HC+OND"))
  levels(df$group3) <- c("HC+OND", "PD")
  table(df %>% select(group, group3))
  compareList <- list(c("HC", "PD"), c("OND", "PD"), c("HC+OND", "PD"))
  
  dfPlt <- data.frame()
  res <- data.frame()
  for (i in seq_len(length(test_vec))) {
    df_i <- df %>% select(group, group3, sex, all_of(test_vec[i]))
    names(df_i)[ncol(df_i)] <- "value"
    
    for (i_group in 1:3) {
      # ------- All -------
      if (i_group < 3) {
        df_temp <- df_i %>% select(group, value, sex)
      } else {
        df_temp <- df_i %>% select(group3, value, sex)
        names(df_temp)[names(df_temp) == "group3"] <- "group"
      }
      
      result_A <- ROC_summary(df_temp,
                              compareList[[i_group]],
                              test_vec2[i],
                              type1_vec[i],
                              type2_vec[i],
                              direction = directions[i])
      dfPlt <- bind_rows(dfPlt, result_A$dfPlt)
      res <- bind_rows(res, result_A$res)
      
      #  ------- Female -------
      df_temp_F <- df_temp %>% filter(sex == "Female") %>% droplevels()
      
      result_F <- ROC_summary(
        df_temp_F,
        compareList[[i_group]],
        test_vec2[i],
        type1_vec[i],
        type2_vec[i],
        sex = "Female",
        cut_all = result_A$cut_all,
        direction = directions[i]
      )
      dfPlt <- bind_rows(dfPlt, result_F$dfPlt)
      res <- bind_rows(res, result_F$res)
      
      #  ------- Male -------
      df_temp_M <- df_temp %>% filter(sex == "Male") %>% droplevels()
      
      result_M <- ROC_summary(
        df_temp_M,
        compareList[[i_group]],
        test_vec2[i],
        type1_vec[i],
        type2_vec[i],
        sex = "Male",
        cut_all = result_A$cut_all,
        direction = directions[i]
      )
      dfPlt <- bind_rows(dfPlt, result_M$dfPlt)
      res <- bind_rows(res, result_M$res)
    }
  }
  # save result
  resList[[i_cohort]] <- res
}

res_PREDIGT1 <- resList[[1]]
res_PREDIGT1$group <- factor(res_PREDIGT1$group, levels = c("PD vs HC", "PD vs OND", "PD vs HC+OND"))

res_all_component <- resList[[2]]
res_all_component$group <- factor(res_all_component$group, levels = c("PD vs HC", "PD vs OND", "PD vs HC+OND"))
```

**Table 3**: in subjects that completed all assessments in phases I and II, for head-to-head comparison

```

```

res_all_component %>% filter(sex == "Male") %>% arrange(group) %>% select(tests:auc)
